senses.en_definition: The body of a dead person; a corpse.

messages.en: Did you see the news earlier? The police have found a body by that river.
Yeah, but they haven't confirmed the person's identity yet, right? I want to wait for a police statement before sharing the news.

senses.en_definition: The English first-person singular object pronoun, used in English quotations or in Malay-English code-switching to refer to the speaker.

messages.en: Give me a call when you get to the lobby, okay? I'll come down and get you.
Okay, I'll call you when I get there. No need to come down yet. I've only just got on the train.
I saw that poster on social media earlier.
Oh, I want to have a look too. Send me the link, will you?

senses.en_definition: A piece of furniture with a flat, horizontal surface supported by legs, used for eating, writing, or placing things on.

messages.en: Are you here yet? I'm out front.
Yeah. I'm sitting at the table by the window. Just come in and you'll see me.
Oh, I see you! I'm coming over now.
